snippet.title: MoSim v26 Trailer ft. WCP CC
snippet.description:
This video unveils MoSim v26 featuring Rebuilt, available to play for free on Steam®, or to download from GitHub: https://mosimulator.com/download/

Join our Discord here: https://discord.gg/mosim

Disclaimer: Modding is not supported in this version. Continue using the Itch version to access v25 mods in the meantime: https://mostudios.itch.io/mosimulator

Some other major changes in this update include:
- Multi-game selection
- Custom robot spawnpoints
- Steam® Remote Play for splitscreen multiplayer

Future updates to look forward to:
- 6 Worlds teams
- Multi-game modding support
- Older games, including Crescendo
- Online multiplayer
- And much more

Video edited by Evan Kruger
Music: Unstoppable by The Score
